_comments.fixedHeaderSelector: Selector for the fixed/sticky site header. Used by 'no-content-under-fixed-header' check to detect overlap.
_comments.settleAfterLoadMs: Wait time after networkidle so the checkout nukeCheckoutGaps timeouts (500ms, 1500ms) and any other deferred JS get to run before we measure.
_comments.preSteps.addToCart: Adds a WooCommerce product to the session cart via ?add-to-cart=. Needed for /cart/ and /checkout/ — otherwise WC redirects away.
_comments.openLoginToggle: If true, clicks .showlogin on the page so the inline guest-login form is visible (otherwise it's display:none and the form-input check skips it).
